description: This file is a bundled JavaScript module (UMD format) for vue-draggable, a Vue.js component for drag-and-drop functionality, which depends on external 'sortablejs'. It includes module definition boilerplate, webpack bootstrap code, and internal module definitions.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Updates sortable options based on newOptionValue, excluding readonly properties.

methods.name: getChildrenNodes
methods.description: Retrieves child nodes, considering functional component mode and transition mode.

methods.name: computeIndexes
methods.description: Computes visible indexes of draggable items after DOM updates.

methods.name: getUnderlyingVm
methods.description: Gets the underlying Vue model instance and index for a given HTML element.

methods.name: getUnderlyingPotencialDraggableComponent
methods.description: Identifies the potential draggable Vue component from a given Vue instance.

methods.name: emitChanges
methods.description: Emits a 'change' event with the provided event data after DOM update.

methods.name: alterList
methods.description: Modifies the list (or value) using a provided function and emits 'input' event.

methods.name: spliceList
methods.description: Splices the list at specified indices.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates item position in the list based on old and new indexes.

methods.name: getRelatedContextFromMoveEvent
methods.description: Determines the context of the related draggable component during a move event.

methods.name: getVmIndex
methods.description: Converts a DOM index to a Vue model index considering visible indexes.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the Vue component instance from default slot.

methods.name: resetTransitionData
methods.description: Resets transition-related data for a specific node index.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Handles drag start event, storing the underlying Vue model.

methods.name: onDragAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of an item via drag, updating list and emitting change.

methods.name: onDragRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of an item via drag, updating list and resetting transition data.

methods.name: onDragUpdate
methods.description: Handles item update during drag, updating list positions and emitting change.

methods.name: updateProperty
methods.description: Updates event property values, adjusting for header offset.

methods.name: computeFutureIndex
methods.description: Calculates the future index of a dragged item based on DOM and related elements.

methods.name: onDragMove
methods.description: Handles drag move event, calling user-defined move function if available.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles end of drag, recomputing indexes.
